sentences.en: The rat the cat the dog chased killed ate the malt.
sentences.zh: 老鼠被猫追，又被狗咬死，吃掉了麦芽。

sentences.en: I guess malt vinegar is more common than white vinegar on fries.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在薯条上，醋陈酿的醋比白醋更常见。

sentences.en: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
sentences.zh: 啤酒根据其麦芽含量征税，所以低麦芽含量的啤酒价格更低。

senses.zh: 麦芽,麦芽酒,啤酒,麦乳精vt.使（谷物）成为麦芽,制麦芽adj.麦芽的,含麦芽的,用麦芽作的
